newsitem.title: UK: U.K. gas consumption rises 19.2 pct June-Aug.
newsitem.headline: U.K. gas consumption rises 19.2 pct June-Aug.

text.p: British consumption of primary fuels -- oil, coal and gas -- rose by 2.1 percent in the three months June to August in comparison with the same period last year, the Department of Trade and Industry said on Tuesday.

Gas consumption saw the biggest growth, up by 19.2 percent, which the DTI attributed to a significant increase in use for electricity generation. There was a corresponding fall in coal consumption by 9.8 percent.
Total primary fuel consumption reached 45.8 million tonnes of oil equivalent (mtoe) in the period, compared to production of 60.4 mtoe.
Oil consumption, which the DTI defines as including deliveries, was up by 2.1 percent. But actual oil use fell to 20 million tonnes, a drop of 2.1 percent from the same period last year.
